idea-plugin.name: MiniBigO
idea-plugin.description:
Shows the estimated time complexity of every Java method in big-O notation, as an inlay hint at the end of the line with the method name.

Example: O(n² log n)

Features

  • Static estimate from loop nesting: for, for-each, while and do-while. Nested loops multiply; of sequential loops the heaviest one counts.
  • Loops whose counter is multiplied or divided are logarithmic; loops with constant bounds are O(1).
  • Can be switched off in Settings | Editor | Inlay Hints | Other | Big-O Complexity.

Limitations

The result is a heuristic. All loops are assumed to run over the same size n. Recursion and method calls count as O(1); lambdas, streams, break and return are not taken into account.
